name: platform-rows
description: Numbered capability rows under a centred heading: a violet rule down each row, the number and title on the left, the body and an optional text link on the right. Live: .apx-sol on the Asset Intelligence Platform page.

title.description: Heading. A line break marks where the desktop heading wraps; phones let it reflow.

title_accent.description: Part of the heading painted with the brand gradient.

items.description: Rows. Each: number (e.g. 01), title, optional keyword (the leading word of the title set in teal, e.g. Track:), body, optional link_label + url for the text link, and optional links (further text links, each {label, url}) under it.
